name: Gonçalo Velho Cabral to the Azores
summary: Sent by Prince Henry far out into the Atlantic, Gonçalo Velho finds the rocks of the Formigas and, the next year, the island of Santa Maria, a third of the way to America. The Azores, nine islands strung across a thousand kilometres of ocean, gave Portuguese ships a landfall on the long loop home from Africa, the volta do mar.

stops.note: Prince Henry's headland, looking out on the open Atlantic.
